_comment: Human-editable deal source. The Decap portal at /admin edits THIS file. scripts/build-promotions.mjs expands it into data/promotions.json, which the site reads. Do not edit promotions.json by hand.

deals.headline: SammyC's Skool is Live
deals.description: SammyC's Skool community is now live. Get direct access to Sam, research peptide modules, vendor intel, and community discussion.

deals.headline: 20% off first order with NEWCOFFEE20, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: New to Coffee and Peppers? Code NEWCOFFEE20 takes 20% off your first order, and SAMMYC stacks another 15% on top at checkout.

deals.headline: Now tracked, 15% off with SAMMYC
deals.description: Orbitrex Peptides is now tracked on MyPeptidePrice. Compare their pricing per mg against every other vendor, with 15% off using code SAMMYC.

deals.headline: Now tracked, 15% off with SAMMYC
deals.description: Aurora Peptides is now tracked in the price comparison catalog. Code SAMMYC applies 15% off. Confirm final pricing and terms at checkout.

deals.headline: 15% off sitewide, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: Aurora Peptides is running 15% off sitewide for the whole of August. Code SAMMYC stacks on top for a further 15% off the reduced price. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: 25% off for military and first responders
deals.description: Solyn Labs offers 25% off for verified military and first responders, and code SAMMYC stacks on top. Eligibility and verification are handled by the vendor, so the prices shown here reflect the standing SAMMYC discount only. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: 20% off for veterans and first responders
deals.description: Orbitrex Peptides offers 20% off for verified veterans and first responders. Code SAMMYC applies 15% off for everyone else. Eligibility and verification are handled by the vendor. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: 20% off with AUGUST20, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: Peptidology is running 20% off all compounds with code AUGUST20. Code SAMMYC stacks on top for a further 10% off the reduced price. Bulk orders carry an additional tiered discount of up to 15%, which varies by quantity and is not reflected in the prices shown here. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: 1 Year Anniversary Sale starts Friday
deals.description: Coffee and Peppers is running a three day 1 Year Anniversary Sale from August 14 through August 16, with a different offer each day and a $1,000 store credit draw running throughout.

deals.headline: 20% off sitewide with ONEYEAR, day 1 of 3
deals.description: Day one of the Coffee and Peppers 1 Year Anniversary Sale. 20% off sitewide with code ONEYEAR, and code SAMMYC stacks for a further 15% off the reduced price. Orders over $350 include a free anniversary gift, an R10 or T10 kit, with free two day shipping. Every $100 spent earns an entry into the $1,000 store credit draw. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: BOGO on kits, day 2 of 3
deals.description: Day two of the Coffee and Peppers 1 Year Anniversary Sale. For the first two hours, buy any one kit and get an R10 or T10 kit free. For the rest of the day, buy any one kit and get a second kit at 50% off. Every $100 spent earns an entry into the $1,000 store credit draw. The prices shown here do not reflect the free or discounted second kit. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: Buy 2 kits get the 3rd free, day 3 of 3
deals.description: Day three of the Coffee and Peppers 1 Year Anniversary Sale. Buy any two kits and get a third free, of equal or lesser value. 20% off sitewide with code ONEYEAR also applies and stacks with SAMMYC. Every $100 spent earns an entry into the $1,000 store credit draw. The prices shown here do not reflect the free third kit. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: 12 MONTH ANNIVERSARY SALE! Use code 12MONTHS + SAMMYC
deals.description:
Glacier Aminos 12-month anniversary sale kicks off 8/1. 12% off sitewide + stacks with code SAMMYC
Code: 12MONTHS

deals.headline: 45% off sitewide, One Year Anniversary
deals.description: Southern Aminos is running their One Year Anniversary Celebration from August 10 through August 30. 45% off sitewide, with code SAMMYC stacking for a further 15% off the reduced price. The vendor states further stacking can reach up to 60% and that flash drops will run throughout the event with select products under $10; neither is reflected in the prices shown here. Over $5,000 in prizes is being given away separately. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: 30% off sitewide, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: 30% off every product. Monday, August 10 through Sunday, August 16 at midnight EST. Volume pricing stacks on top. No code, no minimum, nothing excluded. Stacks with SAMMYC 15%

deals.headline: 15% flash sale, SAMMYC takes 20% here
deals.description: 15% off sitewide flash sale through Thursday, August 13 at midnight EST. Code SAMMYC is worth a full 20% at LabSourced, the biggest code discount on the board. Stacks with SAMMYC 20%

deals.headline: 40% off sitewide, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: Glow Aminos moved up to 40% off sitewide with no announced end date. Code SAMMYC stacks for an additional 15% off the reduced price, for 49% off in total. Free priority shipping over $150. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: 40% off sitewide, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: Flawless Compounds moved up to 40% off sitewide with no announced end date. Code SAMMYC stacks for an additional 15% off the reduced price, for 49% off in total. Free priority shipping over $150. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.description: 20% off sitewide at Disguised Alpha starting Friday, August 14. Code SAMMYC stacks for an additional 10% off the reduced price. New Exenatide aerosol and Semaglutide and Retatrutide pens just launched. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: Back to School, SAMMYC boosted to 25% off sitewide
deals.description: Back to School promotion. Code SAMMYC is boosted from 10% to 25% off sitewide from August 14 at 9:00 AM MST through August 23 at 11:59 PM MST. Volume pricing takes it up to 40% off on orders of 10 or more vials. Mile High is also running a customer giveaway during the sale, where 1 in 20 orders over $300 receives $300 in store credit, applied automatically to the account wallet. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: 30% off sitewide, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: 30% off sitewide at Oneday Compounds with no announced end date. Code SAMMYC stacks for an additional 10% off the reduced price. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: Week 3: 20% off sitewide plus up to 100% back in rewards
deals.description: One Year Anniversary Week 3. 20% off sitewide, and code SAMMYC stacks for another 15% off, as do volume discounts. Orders also earn Instant Rewards store credit based on the merchandise subtotal after all discounts: 25% back at $250 or more, 50% back at $500 or more, and 100% back at $750 or more. Rewards are added after the promotion ends on August 23 and can be redeemed for up to 50% of the product value of a future order. Rewards are store credit with no cash value. Confirm final pricing and rewards terms at checkout.
